r80 directed delta before0.4.30, 2026-10-18.

P23 MT startup warmup: after owned MT health200, before its ready phase, supervisor launches an owned helper in its own process group with the same run token/environment/private temp paths. Helper calls Settings.from_env and the actual OpenAIChatTranslateService constructor with identical configured provider, URL, model and translation_max_tokens as TranslationSession. One explicitly approved synthetic 'Да.' ru→en request therefore uses the real _build_messages template and normal sampling/max-token parameters. Output is discarded; receipt/log contains only startup metadata/latency, movie_credit=false/audio_generated=false/output_discarded=true. No PCM or movie journal outcome is created.
Supervisor checks lease/heartbeat/floor/ownership while waiting, checks a105s total monotonic deadline, and fails startup with typed fatal xt_mt_warmup_failed on helper failure, timeout or invalid receipt. Normal owned cleanup follows, no retries. Real lease/floor failures keep their original guard semantics. XTServices preserves the typed warmup error. Runtime startup health alone is not counted as MT readiness until warmup completes.

MT client deadline now derives from XTRANSLATE_MT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS supplied by xt_mt_request_timeout_seconds (root config default90, range30..90): connect5/readserver+15=>105s. Root fingerprints config. The total warmup bound remains105s independently. No barrier120s/hard900s/first-playback300s/demo25min extension.
Installed vLLM0.14 engine/arg_utils.py:2051 defines --enable-log-requests. entrypoints/openai/cli_args.py:173 defines max_log_len and:257 generates --max-log-len. Launch enables request logs with --max-log-len256. enable_log_outputs remains itsFalse default at:187; synthetic translated output is not logged. Request arrival/prompt logs are bounded. Source excerpts saved in dependency-audit/r80b.

P24 port reservation: retain the already bound P22 SO_REUSEADDR-before-bind implementation, no SO_REUSEPORT, no new edit. Existing active-listener refusal/PID-owned health checks stay intact.

P25 ASR context: session initialization, rebuild and synthetic startup init_streaming_state now use chunk_size_sec2.0, matching installed qwen_asr0.0.6 inference/qwen3_asr.py:590. Unfixed_chunk_num2, unfixed_token_num5, OVERLAP_CHUNKS4, history/reset/commit rules and automatic native language remain unchanged. This deliberately follows Claude's minimal isolated change; the earlier4seconds replay proposal was not applied. Japanese/Spanish ASR partials observed on the Russian scene remain a quality warning; whether2.0s helps is UNPROVEN. No language is forced and no movie text/captions/reference is supplied.

Read-only tokenizer warning review: installed Transformers4.57.6 tokenization_utils_base.py:2390+ invokes the Mistral regex helper for vocab>100000; :2450+ only excludes non-Mistral local models when saved transformers_version<=4.57.2, or skips>=5.0.0. Original LMT config is model_typeqwen3, savedversion4.57.3, so it falls through and sets mistral_config_detected=True despite the model family. Its actual tokenizer.json Split regex exactly matches installed transformers/models/qwen2/tokenization_qwen2.py PRETOKENIZE_REGEX:39. This supports a false Mistral-warning trigger; it is not proof of overall tokenization/ASR quality. No tokenizer/regex changes. Saved actual pattern/config and condition excerpts under dependency-audit/r80b.

Changed code: Qwenserver(3chunk literals), backendservices(MTenvdeadline), XTServices(env/MTlogging/helperargv/faultpropagation), linux_supervisor(ownedwarmup), newmt_warmup.py. Baselines and P23-P25-mt-warmup-asr-context.patch saved; helper separately hash-bound. No tests/imports/apps/builds/GPU/model/warmup operations by worker. Root's authorized run must report real timings and failures; syntheticwarmups never count as movie completion or quality evidence.

0.4.31 audit packaging reference: the public derived pattern/config snapshot is dependency-audit/r80b/lmt-lexical-pattern.json. Its bytes are unchanged; the previous filename triggered the packager's credential-name filter. See P26-AUDIT-PACKAGING.txt. Engine changes above are unchanged.
